basics.name: Mohammad Amin Vakili
basics.label: Software Engineer / Developer
basics.summary: Software engineer from Bandar Abbas, Iran. Python backends with Django and Flask, Vue.js and Electron frontends, and industrial data systems for meters, IoT devices, and factory equipment.

aboutText1: I'm Mohammad Amin Vakili, a software engineer from Bandar Abbas, Iran. I got my start in networking and IT support in 2017, and that infrastructure background still shapes how I build software: practical, observable, and easy to operate.
aboutText2: These days most of my work is Python. With Django and Flask I've built internal portals, REST APIs, an OPC UA data-logging system for industrial equipment, an MQTT pipeline for electricity meter data, and IoT backends for devices like cooling controllers. On the frontend I use Vue.js and Electron — including POS-connected ticketing software — and I publish Grafana dashboards on top of MariaDB and PostgreSQL.
aboutText3: I also run the infrastructure behind my projects: MikroTik routing and firewalls, Linux servers, Nginx and Apache, cron jobs, and monitoring. I like taking a slow manual process and turning it into something automated that just runs.

projects.title: Industrial Data Handler
projects.description_short: Real-time industrial data logging and analysis system.
projects.description_full: Developed server-side system for receiving and processing real-time data from industrial PLCs. Worked with OPC UA protocol to establish communication, read variables, manage sessions, and monitor device status. Built a web-based application with Flask and Python for online log display, data filtering, and real-time system monitoring. Designed Excel output capability in different time bases for engineering reports and technical analysis. Designed and optimized data storage structure and created dedicated APIs for access to historical logs and data. Deployed the system on Linux environment and configured infrastructure to ensure stable performance under high data volume conditions.
features: Real-time OPC UA communication with industrial PLCs
Web panel for live log display and filtering
Excel export in multiple time bases for engineering reports
Optimized storage and dedicated APIs for historical data

projects.title: Production Automation Portal
projects.description_short: Internal portal for workflows and reporting.
projects.description_full: Designed and developed a complete automation system for production planning and existing inventory management including production formula control, raw material management, and finished product cost calculation. Defined and managed multi-level BOM (Bill of Materials) for complex products and production processes. Managed operators with shift-based operation reporting capability considering performance, response time, and mechanical and time limitations. Developed comprehensive reporting system including operator performance, material consumption, production needs, and inventory forecasting. Developed forms and request management with checklist definition capability for workers with specific tolerance and logistics limitations. Backend developed with Django and frontend with Django Templates using MariaDB for data storage. Used a combination of ORM and direct Query to optimize performance and reduce time risk in critical processes. Ensured stable performance and system development capability to respond to organizational operational needs.
features: Multi-level BOM management for complex products
Shift-based operator reporting with performance tracking
Production needs and inventory forecasting reports

projects.title: Meter Data Logging System
projects.description_full: Measured incoming water volume to pump via Delta PLC and transferred data to HMI for display and control. Communicated HMI with MQTT Broker to send several specific registers over dedicated MQTT channels to Python server. Developed Python program to receive data, log, and manage information flow. Designed and developed a web-based panel with Flask for online viewing of logs and register status. Ensured accurate data processing, real-time logging, and user-friendly display of information for operational and control units.
features: Water volume measurement via Delta PLC and HMI
MQTT-based register communication to Python server
Real-time logging and web panel for register status

projects.title: Debt Collection System
projects.description_full: Developed a system to connect to accounting software for managing individual debts in the organization. Created personal link generation capability for viewing individual debt and sending dedicated link to user. Developed debt payment capability with attention to debts and automatic registration of payments in accounting software. Designed comprehensive reporting system for successful and failed payments for financial management and analysis. Backend developed with Python and Flask and frontend with Nuxt.js for fast and interactive user experience. Built communication architecture with accounting software via dedicated API using Cronjob for automatic data updates and processing. Ensured security, transaction correctness, and data compatibility with existing financial systems in the organization.
features: Personal payment links for debt settlement
Automatic payment registration in accounting software

Provided development tools for monitoring and managing threads, increasing efficiency and stability of programs. Designed modular APIs for use by other open-source project developers. Link: https://github.com/dot1mav/UseFul

projects.title: OwnFirewall
projects.description_full: Developed an open-source project for automatic configuration of iptables on user servers and systems. Goal: Simplifying firewall management for individuals who don't have complete experience with iptables. Developed automation mechanisms to set security rules including opening and closing ports, setting access, and applying standard security policies. Designed usable interface and automatic scripts to increase server security and reduce human errors. Provided development tools and standard documentation for easier use by other developers and system administrators. Link: https://github.com/dot1mav/OwnFirewall
